title: Picnic Party, Red Bank (NYPL b11707653-G90F459 013F)
blurb: * Includes views by Pine Bros., J. Good, S.R. Morse and other photographers and publishers. Robert Dennis Collection of Stereoscopic Views. Views of Central and Southern New Jersey including Gloucester City, Red Bank, Trenton, Vineland, and views along the Shrewbury River, including views of churches, bridges, homes, schools, state asylum and grounds, interiors, a porcelein factory, fires, group portraits, including children, horse and cart.
cond: Rectified 2026. Halves registered to 0.13% vertical error and 0.05° of rotation. Depth measured moderate (2.17% of frame width); hung in the VR Parlor at full size.
collection_name: Robert N. Dennis Collection of Stereoscopic Views
